text:
Between 14:02 and 14:31 UTC, 12% of API requests failed with HTTP 502.

A deploy at 14:02 UTC removed the cache warmup step. As a result, new instances served requests before the cache was ready. The failed requests returned HTTP 502.

At 14:21 UTC, the on-call engineer identified the cause. At 14:27 UTC, the team reverted the deploy. At 14:31 UTC, error rates returned to normal.

No data was lost. Only requests during this period were affected.

The team will add the cache warmup step to the pre-deploy checks. The team will also add an alert for missing warmup steps.
